snippet.title: COMPROMISED - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
I MADE MY OWN HORROR GAME :D

**WISHLIST ON STEAM:** https://store.steampowered.com/app/3914830/Compromised/

After nearly a year of development, I'm finally excited to share the official trailer for my very own horror game!

**The goal is simple: Survive until 6 AM.**

You're alone in your house, and there's a killer outside trying to find a way in. You'll have to manage your limited power, monitor security cameras, protect vulnerable entrances, and react to unexpected sabotages throughout the night.

But there's a catch...

You're not dealing with just one enemy.

While a killer searches for opportunities to break into your home, a second enemy is actively sabotaging your defenses, creating openings for the killer to exploit.

Every decision matters, and one mistake could cost you the entire night.

**THE STORY BEHIND THE GAME:**

I originally spent around eight months developing this game with very little prior game development experience.

Just as I was getting close to finishing it, my computer's power supply failed and took my SSD with it, causing me to lose nearly all of my progress.

And because I hadn't made proper backups, I had to start completely over.

I genuinely considered giving up on the project. Losing that much work was incredibly discouraging.

But eventually, I realized that although I'd lost my progress, I hadn't lost everything I'd learned along the way.

So I decided to take all that experience and rebuild the game from scratch, improving the mechanics, gameplay, and overall experience.

And I'm genuinely so much happier with how this version turned out.

After all the setbacks, I'm incredibly excited to finally share it with you guys.

**If the game looks interesting, please consider adding it to your Steam wishlist!** It's completely free and helps me out tremendously as a small indie developer.

🔗 **STEAM:** https://store.steampowered.com/app/3914830/Compromised/

Thank you all so much for the support. I can't wait for you to play it!

#HorrorGame #IndieHorror #IndieGame #SteamGames
